decisions.scenario: Finding a cheap Portuguese restaurant in central Cambridge and getting its address

turns.speaker: Learner
turns.text: I would like a cheap restaurant that serves Portuguese food.

turns.speaker: Assistant
turns.text: I found one in the south part of town and one in the centre.

turns.speaker: Learner
turns.text: Could I have the address of the restaurant in the centre, please?

turns.speaker: Assistant
turns.text: Nandos is at 33–34 Saint Andrews Street.

decisions.notes: Retained because 33–34 Saint Andrews Street adds source-backed central Nandos address coverage not present in the existing reviewed Nandos dialogues; wording and punctuation are normalized without changing the fact.

Rejected because the source turn contains the malformed address “40270 King Street City Centre”. Repairing the intended street number would require inference beyond editorial normalization; the phone number is already covered by dlg.multiwoz.woz20135.json.
